title: Slovakia’s Fico snubbed Poland and Europe, insulted Ukraine veterans (again), and callously lied about Putin’s war (Ukraine Battlefield update, day 1,734)
lede: As Slovak PM Robert Fico shrugs off war in Lviv and snubs both Warsaw and Brussels, thousands of grieving families, maimed soldiers and fresh Russian strikes in western Ukraine expose just how far his rhetoric has drifted from the front’s brutal reality.
